title: Hindle 1990 lumbar ISL+SSL force at 10 deg flexion (IAR 50 mm, 0.5 deg/s)

quantity.name: ligament force at 10 deg flexion
quantity.definition: tensile force in ISL+SSL complex at 10 deg flexion with rotation axis 50 mm anterior to ligament centre (= extension moment / 0.05 m); moment in extra key moment_Nm

source.authors: Hindle RJ, Pearcy MJ, Cross A
source.sample: 13 ISL+SSL specimens (two adjacent spinous processes) from 11 cadavers (7 M, 4 F); human lumbar interspinous + supraspinous ligament complex, L2-L3 to L4-L5

protocol.summary: Bone-ISL/SSL-bone units (halves of adjacent spinous processes) pinned to two arms rotating about a fixed axis (rack-and-pinion on Hounsfield machine) placed 30-50 mm anterior to the ligament centre (simulating the IAR); 10 deg of flexion rotation; 5 cycles, 5th recorded (preconditioning); 100% humidity, 37 C, Ringer's saline; low rate 0.5 deg/s (all), high rate 12.5 deg/s (specimens 9-13). Force = moment / 50 mm.
how_to_simulate: Mount the ISL+SSL between two spinous-process halves and rotate them 10 deg in flexion about an axis 50 mm anterior to the ligament centre
Use 0.5 deg/s (or 12.5 deg/s) and record the 5th cycle
Report the ligament force (moment / 0.05 m) and extension moment at 10 deg

extraction.check_notes: Tables 1-2 read from 200-dpi render. Mean/SD rows computed by the extractor. Values are at 10 deg rotation (end of imposed range), NOT failure. doi not printed.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
